purpose: Evaluate a lean volatility ANN and conservative regime-based capital policies from saved purged walk-forward predictions without retraining or opening the sealed holdout.

policies.ann_stress_only: Hold the ANN sleeve only when the training-threshold regime label is stress.
policies.ann_trend_down_cash: Move the ANN sleeve to cash when the training-threshold regime label is trend_down.

turnover_policy: Charge underlying turnover while active plus full invested-weight entry or exit turnover when the regime gate changes.
